title: 机器学习与生成式AI项目合集
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了使用Python构建的机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI和AI自动化项目，涵盖AI智能体、LLM应用、NLP、计算机视觉、API及自动化工具，代码整洁可扩展且文档完善，旨在解决实际业务问题。
summary_en: This GitHub repository showcases real-world projects built with Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and AI Automation, featuring AI agents, LLM apps, NLP, computer vision, APIs, and automation tools with clean, scalable, well-documented code to solve real business challenges.
